design.continuation: one named capability, nuisance-separation or changing-profile boundary; never tune a failed profile into a positive result
design.costs: all actual search attempts, training, all rejected production, reader reconstruction/search and inference; batch search is shared within one public context
design.eligibility: validated P03, O01-O04 and M01-M04 separation instruments; scientific gains are not admission gates
design.fairness: all readers receive identical public bytes; ordinary stable mixture, task-cost, public surface habit and direct joint rivals
design.null: absent additional coverage/quality profile retains ordinary task and execution-cost preferences
design.profile_dimensions: constructor-defined coverage versus orientation quality, beyond ordinary required-part task and paid primitive cost
design.scope: conditional known public task, acquired training, physical/search constraints, considered menu and publication law; no human-value claim
design.support: five explicit profile schedules over actually found legal stopped plans; no continuous unrestricted preference recovery
design.target: held-out unselected executed choice and revision cost after eight dated decisions
design.trajectory: V01 independent episodes from an acquired old state; V02 eight sequential retained revisions with purpose and price crossed against profile dynamics

design.collision: eight forced stop-only dated episodes have identical public histories for all three rivals, constructed before any unknown draw
design.continuation: expand a named intervention-cost or identifiability boundary; indistinguishable rivals remain ambiguous
design.costs: query fees in nats-valued decision cost, physical production/search, and separately counted model inquiry/prediction work
design.fairness: all arms have the same public law and possible interventions; direct-all receives exactly the all-policy evidence
design.queries: open alternatives, optionally grant six steps, optionally remove the audience incentive; each query causes a real new execution
design.rivals: actual low-to-high profile change; stable low profile with two-step capability; stable low profile with external coverage-minus-quality incentive
design.scope: finite known-rival planners in constructed assembly; no inference of human values, hidden motives or arbitrary unknown planners
design.target: new neutral-audience full-time maker choice; rival-cause uncertainty and known historical programs remain separate
